title: NEXT-CODEX-POST-REDTEAM - StructuralNumbers Stage 3 structural GCD as run_mu projections
purpose: StructuralNumbers Stage 3: express integer GCD as pure RCX projections through run_mu by lifting the landed COMPARE and SUBTRACT projection tables. The engine must use Euclidean subtraction over non-negative N operands with no host gcd, mod, divide, comparison, or subtraction primitive.
evidence_delta: (1) New gate proves integer GCD is expressible as pure RCX projections through run_mu by Euclidean subtraction lifting the landed COMPARE and SUBTRACT tables. (2) The result is structurally and content-hash equal to encode(math.gcd(a,b)) for the lean corpus, with math.gcd oracle-only in mu/tests. (3) net_host_semantic_delta stays 0 and rationals can use structural gcd for lowest-terms reduction in the next wave.
progress_proof_before: Stage 3 has structural add, compare, multiply, and subtract gates, but GCD needed for rational reduction has no structural-Mu expression; using host gcd would add forbidden bootstrap host authority.
progress_proof_after: Integer GCD runs as run_mu projections by composing landed compare and subtract through lifting, proven equal to math.gcd by canonical structural equality, so rational reduction can proceed without host gcd.
scope_summary: Add a Python-only L4 gate for structural GCD and the required growth-cap tracker update. This wave is gate-only and uses TASKS.md as tracker-sync authority.

work_items: Create mu/tests/l4_gates/test_structural_numbers_gcd.py implementing the _gcd state machine with zero dispatch, lifted compare dispatch, lifted subtract work slots, and _gcd re-seeding after each strict positive difference.
Import and lift COMPARE_PROJECTIONS plus _v from the landed compare gate and SUB_PROJECTIONS from the landed subtract gate; do not copy or reimplement their projection logic.
Use the lean corpus only: gcd pairs (0,0), (5,0), (0,4), (4,2), (6,4), and (6,3), with operands no larger than 6 and at most two Euclidean steps for compute cases.
Assert canonical structural equality, content-hash equality, valid canonical N numeral shape, stall fixpoint, and decode-to-host as supporting evidence only.
Mark run_mu engine assertions with pytest.mark.l4_expensive and pytest.mark.slow; any fast guard that transitively references run_mu must carry an in-function # SPEED_OK comment.
Bump CAP_TEST_FILES plus one in mu/tests/docs/test_growth_caps.py with the wave-specific founder override comment.
Run the evidence command and collect the L4 indicator artifact.
constraints: Use the pipeline launcher and dispatcher path before any direct manual implementation or commit path.
No runtime, substrate, seed, registry, projection seed, JS parity, or production Mu semantic file may change in this wave.
No new host primitive and no host gcd, mod, divide, comparison, or subtraction in the engine; math.gcd is oracle-only in mu/tests.
Do not reimplement compare or subtract; lift the already landed projection tables.
Keep the corpus bounded to operands no larger than 6 and at most two Euclidean steps per compute case.
JS parity is deferred to a separate follow-up wave.
stop_conditions: Stop done when the evidence command passes and the indicator artifact is collected.
Halt as POLICY_BOUND if integer GCD cannot be expressed without host gcd or host mod.
If the lean corpus exceeds the nightly 900 second budget, reduce corpus only within the packet bounds before escalating.
If the gate requires touching runtime, substrate, seed, or JS production files, re-scope rather than relaxing the boundary.
Do not commit without a real handoff artifact and gate-green evidence.
